en: The Third Adhyāya in the Eighth Aṣṭaka.
Sūktas of the Tenth Maṇḍala.
72. The seventy-second sūkta, beginning ⟦ದೇವಾನಾಂ ನು ವಯಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The various meanings and uses of the word ⟦ಯುಗ⟧.
The natural (prākṛta) and the modified (vaikṛta) creations.
Divisions of time.
Yuga, manvantara, kalpa, etc.
The question of being (sat) arising from non-being (asat).
The origin of Aditi and Dakṣa.
The nature of Aditi, etc.
Discussion of the subject of Dakṣa.
The deities Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryamā.
73. The seventy-third sūkta, beginning ⟦ಜನಿಷ್ಠಾ ಉಗ್ರಃ ಸಹಸೇ⟧
The killing of the asura Namuci by Indra.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ವಯಃ ಸುಪರ್ಣಾಃ⟧.
74. The seventy-fourth sūkta, beginning ⟦ವಸೂನಾಂ ವಾ⟧
75. The seventy-fifth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಪ್ರ ಸು ವ ಅಪಃ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The river Sarasvatī.
The conversation between the seer Viśvāmitra and the rivers.
The principal rivers beginning with Gaṅgā, and their description.
76. The seventy-sixth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಆ ವ ಋಂಜಸೆ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the soma plant and the pressing stones, etc.
77. The seventy-seventh sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಭ್ರಪುಷ್ಪಃ⟧
78. The seventy-eighth sūkta, beginning ⟦ವಿಪ್ರಾಸೋ ನ⟧
79. The seventy-ninth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಪಶ್ಯಮಸ್ಯ ಮಹತಃ⟧
80. The eightieth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಗ್ನಿಃ ಸಪ್ತಿಂ⟧
81. The eighty-first sūkta, beginning ⟦ಯ ಇಮಾ ವಿಶ್ವಾ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—discussion of Viśvakarman.
The dissolution and the order of creation brought about by Viśvakarman, etc.
Detailed explanation of the special meaning of the Ṛk ⟦ಯ ಇಮಾ⟧.
What means Viśvakarman had when he created the world.
Viśvakarman created without any means or materials.
Discussion of the creation of the world, etc.
The order of creation of the worlds Bhūr, etc.
Explanation of the Ṛk ⟦ವಿಶ್ವಕರ್ಮನ್ ಹವಿಷಾ⟧.
The nature of the sacrifice called ⟦ಸರ್ವಹತ್⟧ performed by Viśvakarman, etc.
Viśvakarman's self-sacrifice as the root cause of creation, etc.
82. The eighty-second sūkta, beginning ⟦ಚಕ್ಷುಷಃ ಪಿತಾ⟧
The view that the whole creation came from the water that enveloped the world before creation, etc.
The meaning of the word ⟦ಪುರುಷ⟧; why the Supreme Self is called Puruṣa.
The greatness of the vital breath (prāṇa), etc.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ವಿಶ್ವಕರ್ಮಾ ವಿಮನಾ⟧.
The nature and greatness of Viśvakarman, etc.
Although Viśvakarman is the cause of the origin of all the world, he is distinct from the world.
The conversation between the seer Yājñavalkya and Gārgya on the subject of the worlds.
Viśvakarman's special powers, strength and capacities, etc.
Neither the gods nor other beings can know Viśvakarman's nature and glory.
The sūkta relating to Viśvakarman stated in the Taittirīya Saṃhitā.
83. The eighty-third sūkta, beginning ⟦ಯಸ್ತೇ ಮನ್ಯೋ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The deities of mental states (bhāvanā)—Śraddhā, Medhā, Prajñā, Satya, Tapas, Dama, Śama, Dāna, Dharma, Yajña, Manas, Saṃvatsara or Time, Dakṣiṇā, Ānanda, Śānti, etc.
The nature of the deity Manyu.
The application (viniyoga), fruit (phalaśruti), etc., stated in the Ṛg-vidhāna for these sūktas.
84. The eighty-fourth sūkta, beginning ⟦ತ್ವಯಾ ಮನ್ಯೋ⟧
Explanation of the Ṛk ⟦ತ್ವಯಾ ಮನ್ಯೋ⟧.
85. The eighty-fifth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಸತ್ಯೇನೋತ್ತಭಿತಾ ಭೂಮಿಃ⟧
The earlier story of the marriage of Soma and the goddess Sūryā.
The contest among the gods at Sūryā's wedding.
How the Aśvin gods won the contest, etc.
Explanation of the spiritual principle in the matter of Sūryā's wedding.
Explanation of the word ⟦ಸೋಮ⟧, description of the soma plant, the method of pressing and preparing the soma juice, etc.
Derivation of the form of the word ⟦ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ⟧, etc.
Two kinds of explanation of the deity Soma.
Explanation of the Ṛk ⟦ಯತ್ತ್ವಾ ದೇವ⟧—the meaning with reference to the herb and to the moon.
Description of the goddess Sūryā's wedding, etc.
Explanation of the stomas.
The twenty-seven nakṣatras and their presiding deities.
Description of the chariot of the Aśvin gods.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ನವೋನವೋ ಭವತಿ⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಸುಕಿಂಶುಕಂ⟧.
The Gandharvas—Viśvāvasu and others.
Explanation of the words ⟦ಶೇಷಂ⟧ and ⟦ವೈತಸ⟧.
Explanation of the sentence ⟦ತೃತೀಯೋ ಅಗ್ನಿಷ್ಟೇ ಪತಿಃ⟧.
Explanation of the meaning of the word ⟦ರೂಪಸಮೃದ್ಧ⟧, etc.
Explanation of the meaning and derivation of the word ⟦ದೇವರ⟧, etc.
The deity ⟦ಮಾತರಿಶ್ವಾ⟧.
Here ends the Third Adhyāya in the Eighth Aṣṭaka.
The Fourth Adhyāya.
86. The eighty-sixth sūkta, beginning ⟦ವಿ ಹಿ ಸೋತೋರಸೃಕ್ಷತ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the subject of Vṛṣākapi.
The dialogue among Indra, Indrāṇī and Indra's son Vṛṣākapi.
The application (viniyoga) stated in the Ṛg-vidhāna for this sūkta.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಇಂದ್ರಾಣೀಮಾಸು ನಾರಿಷು⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ನಾಹಮಿಂದ್ರಾಣಿ ರಾರಣ⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ವೃಷಾಕಪಾಯಿ ರೇವತಿ⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಪುನರೇಹಿ ವೃಷಾಕಪೇ⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಯದುದಂಚಃ⟧.
87. The eighty-seventh sūkta, beginning ⟦ರಕ್ಷೋಹಣಂ ವಾಜಿನಂ⟧
Introduction—the deity ⟦ರಕ್ಷೋಹಾಗ್ನಿಃ⟧.
88. The eighty-eighth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಹವಿಷ್ಪಾಂತಮಜರಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The subject of Sūrya.
The subject of Vaiśvānara Agni (according to Yāska's Nirukta).
Explanation of the word ⟦ಮಿಥನ⟧.
The various meanings of the word ⟦ನ⟧.
Explanation of the devayāna and pitṛyāṇa paths.
Explanation of the deities ⟦ದೇವ್ಯೌ ಹೋತಾರ್⟧, etc.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಯಾವನ್ಮಾತ್ರಮುಷಸಃ⟧.
89. The eighty-ninth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಇಂದ್ರಂ ಸ್ತವಾ ನೃತಮಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the subject of Indra, general description.
The mutual relation between Indra and Varuṇa.
Description of the slaying of the asura Vṛtra.
Why Prajāpati has the name ⟦ಕಃ⟧.
Why Indra has the name Marutvān.
The killing of the asura Namuci by Indra.
Why Indra is called Ṛjīṣī.
The killing of the asura Varaha by Indra.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಆಪಾಂತಮನ್ಯುಃ⟧.
90. The ninetieth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಸಹಸ್ರಶೀರ್ಷಾ ಪುರುಷಃ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
Why this sūkta is called the Puruṣa-sūkta; explanation of the word ⟦ಪುರುಷ⟧, etc.
The seer of the sūkta, Nārāyaṇa.
Derivation of the word ⟦ನಾರಾಯಣ⟧, etc.
The various meanings of the word ⟦ಪುರುಷ⟧.
Explanation of the meaning of the word ⟦ಸಹಸ್ರ⟧.
Detailed explanation of what is said in the Ṛg-vidhāna and elsewhere of the application (viniyoga), fruit (phalaśruti), glory (māhātmya), etc., of this sūkta.
Explanation of the first Ṛk, ⟦ಸಹಸ್ರಶೀರ್ಷಾ ಪುರುಷಃ⟧.
Explanation of the words ⟦ದಶಾಂಗುಲಂ⟧, ⟦ಅತ್ಯತಿಷ್ಠತ್⟧, etc.
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The second Ṛk, ⟦ಪುರುಷ ಏವೇದಂ ಸರ್ವಂ⟧.
Explanation of the sentence ⟦ಯದ್ಯೂತಂ ಯಚ್ಚ ಭವ್ಯಂ⟧, etc.
Explanation of the sentence ⟦ಅಮೃತತ್ವಸ್ಯೇಶಾನಃ⟧, etc.
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The third Ṛk, ⟦ಏತಾವಾನಸ್ಯ ಮಹಿಮಾ⟧.
Explanation of the principles of the perishable (kṣara) and the imperishable (akṣara).
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The fourth Ṛk, ⟦ತ್ರಿಪಾದೂರ್ಧ್ವ ಉದ್ವೈತ್ಪುರುಷಃ⟧.
Explanation of the word ⟦ತ್ರಿಪಾಚ್ಛಬ್ದ⟧.
The nature of the worlds, etc.
Explanation of the space of the heart (hṛdayākāśa) and the small space (daharākāśa).
The special meaning of the word ⟦ಪಾದ⟧.
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The fifth Ṛk, ⟦ತಸ್ಮಾದ್ವಿರಾಳಜಾಯತ⟧.
The various orders of creation, etc.
The meaning of the word ⟦ವಿರಾಟ್⟧, etc.
What is the original principle of the world?
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The sixth Ṛk, ⟦ಯತ್ಪುರುಷೇಣ ಹವಿಷಾ⟧.
The view that Prajāpati is ten-fold in his offering (daśahotṛ).
The nature of the daśahotṛ, etc.
The manner in which Prajāpati created as the daśahotṛ.
The four-, five-, six- and seven-fold hotṛs.
Prajāpati himself is of the nature of the year (the Self of Time).
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The seventh Ṛk, ⟦ತಂ ಯಜ್ಞಂ ಬರ್ಹಿಷಿ⟧.
The deities called the Sādhyas.
The main purport of the Ṛk.
Special explanation of the Sādhyas.
The eighth Ṛk, ⟦ತಸ್ಮಾದ್ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಸರ್ವಹುತಃ⟧.
The nature of the sacrifice called Sarvahut or Sarvamedha, etc.
The greatness of ghee (ājya), etc.
The origin of animals; the relation between animals and the wind.
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The ninth Ṛk, ⟦ತಸ್ಮಾದ್ಯಜ್ಞಾತ್ಸರ್ವಹುತಃ⟧.
The origin of the Ṛg and the other Vedas.
The main purport of the Ṛk.
Explanation of the various metres, their names, the number of syllables, etc.
The tenth Ṛk, ⟦ತಸ್ಮಾದಶ್ವಾ ಅಜಾಯಂತ⟧.
The main purport of the Ṛk.
The eleventh Ṛk, ⟦ಯತ್ಪುರುಷಂ ವ್ಯದಧುಃ⟧.
The twelfth Ṛk, ⟦ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣೋsಸ್ಯಮುಖಮಾಸೀತ್⟧.
The origin of the castes (varṇa), Brāhmaṇa and the rest, etc.
Who are the people called Ārya and Dāsa (Dasyu)?
The opinions of Western scholars on how the division of castes arose, etc.
The close relation between sacrifice and the Brāhmaṇa.
Scriptural statements to the effect that all castes were born of Brahman and that there is no difference in their excellence.
The thirteenth Ṛk, ⟦ಚಂದ್ರಮಾ ಮನಸೋ ಜಾತಃ⟧.
The fourteenth Ṛk, ⟦ನಾಭ್ಯಾ ಆಸೀದಂತರಿಕ್ಷಂ⟧.
The fifteenth Ṛk, ⟦ಸಪ್ತಾ ಸ್ಯಾಸನ್ಪರಿಧಯಃ⟧.
The sixteenth Ṛk, ⟦ಯಜ್ಞೇನ ಯಜ್ಞಮಯಜಂತ ದೇವಾಃ⟧.
Explanation of the meaning of the word ⟦ನಾಕ⟧.
Explanation of the sentence ⟦ಯೆಜ್ಞೇನ ಯಜ್ಞಮಯಜಂತ⟧, etc.
The deities called the Sādhyas.
91. The ninety-first sūkta, beginning ⟦ಸಂ ಜಾಗೃವದ್ಭಿಃ⟧
92. The ninety-second sūkta, beginning ⟦ಯಜ್ಞಸ್ಯ ವೋ ರಥ್ಯಂ⟧
93. The ninety-third sūkta, beginning ⟦ಮಹಿ ದ್ಯಾವಾಪೃಥಿವೀ⟧
94. The ninety-fourth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಪ್ರೈತೇ ವದಂತು⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the pressing stones (grāvan) that crush the soma plants, the soma juice, etc.
Explanation of the Ṛk ⟦ಪ್ರೈತೇ ವದಂತು⟧.
Here ends the Fourth Adhyāya in the Eighth Aṣṭaka.
